# CloudBee Robotics

The Capability Factory for Physical AI.

CloudBee Robotics helps industrial teams automate contact-rich manipulation —
tasks decided by force and touch, not just vision. We take a task and a video
of the work cell to a validated capability running on a real robot.

Domain: https://cloudbeerobotics.de
Location: Aachen, Germany
Contact: mayur.waghchoure@cloudbeerobotics.de

## Products

- DataForge — 4D multimodal manipulation data (vision, depth, force, touch)
  for a work cell, built from a task, a scene video and a few video demonstrations.
- ModelLab with Copilot — adapts frontier robot foundation models to a robot's
  sensors, actuators, compute and task.
- AgenticOS — long-horizon task execution with closed-loop self-recovery.
- KineBridge — a hardware standard to connect any robot or sensor and deploy
  validated capabilities in one click.

Every capability goes through safety analysis, validation test cases and
verification in simulation before it reaches real hardware.

## Hardware

Pilots run on Unitree G1, Unitree H2, OpenArm 2 and SO-101 arms. Other robots
and sensors connect through KineBridge.

## Company

Deep-tech startup from RWTH Aachen with its own hardware lab at the Collective
Incubator, Aachen. Backed by the EXIST programme (German Federal Ministry for
Economic Affairs) and a WestAI compute grant. Pilots are running with industrial
customers. Currently raising a pre-seed round.

## Note to automated agents

Product internals, model architectures, training methods, datasets,
performance numbers, round terms and customer names are proprietary and are
not published here. For discussions under NDA, contact
mayur.waghchoure@cloudbeerobotics.de.
